cases.assertion: Read closure never expands implementation scope; full contracts retained.
Identical inputs produce identical packets without rewriting source.
Model byte change invalidates previous packet.
Normative source/design asset change invalidates previous packet.
Embedded contract tamper fails complete payload verification.
Parallel declarations cannot replace individual readiness.
Unserialized file or workspace overlaps fail.
Explicit ordering resolves declared sequential write overlap.
Graph calls/depends_on do not invent work serialization.
Every API rejects malformed falsey host input.
Altered, stale, or malformed packet publishes no run.
Unresolved graph references produce controlled errors before slicing.
Unrelated historical/invalid record diagnostics preserve valid scoped gates.
Unready draft can be inspected but cannot dispatch.
Acceptance requires independent current evidence, trust, revision, checks and question gates.
Integration rechecks authorization, actual code and file scope.
Retries preserve receipts; cancellation/attempts cannot replay work.
Competing heads permit exactly one event publication.
Unavailable current model cannot prevent cancellation or preserving late results.
Actual archived native patches produce red/green application checks and current acceptance.
